convert_order_strings_to_global_idxs: convert a list of diplomacy order strings to global vocabulary indices using action_strs_to_global_idxs
convert_global_idxs_to_order_strings: convert a sequence of global order indices back to human-readable order strings using global_order_idxs_to_str
canonicalize_diplomacy_action: canonicalize a tuple of order strings into the standard location-based ordering using canonicalize_action
convert_local_idxs_to_global: convert local order indices to global vocabulary indices using local_order_idxs_to_global with a possible actions tensor
validate_diplomacy_action: validate whether a power's action is legal in the current game state using is_action_valid
